newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless strong buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Payless strong buy repeated.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said Wednesday it reiterated a strong buy rating on Payless ShoeSource Inc with a six- to 12-month price target on the stock of $45.
--On an operating basis (excluding nonrecurring charges and spinoff costs), Gruntal estimates Payless' 1996 Q4 EPS will rise 47 percent to $0.39 from $0.26 the prior year.
--Analyst Michael Conn in a report said, "We forecast EPS growth of 14 to 15 percent in FY97."
--Payless ShoeSource, a footwear retailer, traded up 2-1/8 to 39-1/4.
